fixes: Take the type off the plates. The counter is a letterbox strip with hard horizontal cuts at about y 295 and y 1165 and flat violet bands carrying the type. Lower the camera to a counter height three quarter view so the walnut top runs back to a lit office wall at the top; bring the counter front forward as a lit object (laminate face, rounded nosing, kick shadow, panel seams) and seat the type in its shading. Remove the stretched streaks on the counter edge.

Stage the service as one act: loose papers and the diskette at the customer's edge nearest the camera, the tabbed report slid across toward them on a diagonal with a fanned tab edge and a drag shadow. Grow the pair to at least half the frame. Real walnut grain and contact darkening.
